supersedes.reason: Independent review confirmed the reference lineage and visual baseline but found a dangling dialog name, incomplete evidence/uncertainty APIs, an undeclared standalone package boundary, and structural/style validator false greens. This manifest preserves the original submission while binding the reviewed remediation and exact regression evidence.

checks.result: The exact clean remediation commit passed all 25 desktop-profile commands in 580.54 seconds, including 147 foundation tests, 32 desktop tests, all nine package/application/native commands, six catalog theme/zoom cases, 32 production routes, 139 browser workflows, 390 keyboard cases, 64 responsive cases, 64 visual captures, and the immutable performance gate. Report SHA-256: 82421edd6fa0419be2e1fd055cc5b8c8614aa0b7310702f13a6b0325d8739897.

Package-local strict type checking and two public-runtime/tree-shaking tests pass. The test imports the package by its public name, resolves React and ui-tokens through declared workspace/peer contracts, proves the dialog title referent exists and is nonempty, and proves unused dialog/table code is removed from a StatusBadge-only consumer bundle.

All 21 focused gate, catalog, accessibility, dependency-inventory, and literal-style regressions pass, including comment-only component inventory, dangling aria-labelledby, named CSS colors, inline TSX styles, generated dependency-directory exclusion, and exact independently reviewed gate-hardening provenance.

The full task range passes with exactly nine governed implementation files, unchanged approved reference RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.3/package db13c8d5..., and one exact six-file gate-hardening envelope immediately preceded by the independent CHANGES_REQUESTED planning transition.

evidence: DialogSurface now renders a nonempty h2 whose id exactly matches aria-labelledby in both public-package SSR and the real Chromium catalog.

EvidenceStateBadge exposes all seven governed evidence identities and UncertaintyState exposes all four governed uncertainty identities as typed, runtime-validated, visible text that does not depend on color.
The complete catalog passes light/dark contrast, structural inventory, semantic reference, minimum-control, and horizontal-fit checks at 100%, 150%, and 200% zoom.
Regression tests reject the four independent-review attacks: comment-only Panel inventory, missing dialog title targets, named CSS literal colors, and inline TSX style literals.

CSS declarations are parsed by property and permit visual values only through governed variables or the narrowly enumerated non-color structural grammar; exported component identities and catalog classes are structurally inspected rather than substring-counted.
Public component identities reject unsupported semantic, evidence, and uncertainty values at runtime.

ui-components now declares ui-tokens as a workspace dependency, React as an exact peer, and a locked standalone verification toolchain; application TypeScript resolution no longer bypasses package exports through path aliases.
Package-local type/runtime/tree-shaking checks run as the first application command, and frozen pnpm importers bind the public token package plus exact toolchain versions.
Generated node_modules, dist, and target directories are excluded from authored UI inventory under an independently reviewed exact hardening envelope, while real source remains fail-closed.
The approved Academic Minimal 1.3 reference and all 54 governed reference hashes remain unchanged.

The task-bound UI contract now exactly lists the nine governed package files, including the standalone TypeScript contract; no alternate visual system, baseline rewrite, native privilege, or later-task behavior was introduced.
All 64 approved production visual captures and the commit-bound performance thresholds pass at the exact clean remediation commit.
